description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. D. M. L. Dissanayake was Selected as the member of the Kegalle Urban Council - Declare that Mr. K. B. S. C. Kudagoda was Selected as the member of the Kegalle P/S.
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Kegalle Urban Council and Kegalle Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This falls under electoral processes and related matters, specifically addressing vacancies in elected positions, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
